Subject: Security walkthrough availability for SOC 2 / DPA / pen test

Hi Irene and Ben,

Thanks again for the quick responses during onboarding. Our InfoSec team would like to run the formal walkthrough covering: SOC 2 control mapping, DPA clauses we flagged, and a short pen-test scope discussion — total ~90 minutes. We operate teams across APAC/EU/US so it would be helpful to pick a window that rotates the primary presenters so no single timezone is repeatedly impacted.

Suggested agenda (high level):
- 5 min intros and roles
- 30 min SOC 2 controls & evidence locations
- 25 min DPA items and data flows (logs/retention)
- 25 min pen-test scope & vendor constraints
- 5 min next steps and artifacts handoff

Open windows from our side (all in UTC):
- Tue Nov 9 16:00-17:30 UTC
- Thu Nov 11 09:00-10:30 UTC
- Mon Nov 15 14:00-15:30 UTC

We attached our questionnaire (Finovate_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) so you can see what we expect to review. If any of these slots clash with your vendors or internal blackout windows, can you propose alternatives? We prefer to avoid late-night hours for our EU team.

Best,
Ava Lyons
Head of Security Operations
Finovate Capital

- Tue Nov 16 09:00 UTC (Redwood EU-friendly; Marissa primary)
